job: Bring the parcel at the kerb up the driveway to the front door
understood_as: Pick up the small parcel at the kerb and carry it up the driveway to the front door.
steps: Pick up the small parcel at the kerb
Carry it up the driveway toward the front door

demos.why: Shows how the hand reaches for and lifts a box standing on its long edge.
Shows how firmly to pinch the box so it does not slip or get crushed.

questions: The front door is not a located spot in the building. Can someone mark where the front door is in the scan? Until then the robot can only take the parcel to the way out.
Is the parcel at the kerb the small 20 x 15 x 6 cm box, and roughly how heavy is it?
unmet: Putting the parcel down at the front door itself: the planner can only deliver to the way out, not to a specific door.
